picks.headline: Samsung FCC Approval Signals Gentle Monster & Warby Parker Smart Glasses Nearing Release
picks.excerpt: Samsung’s long-awaited smart glasses have cleared FCC testing, suggesting their release is right around the corner. The News Two distinct SM-O200P and SM-O200J have appeared in FCC filings, which is typically one of the last steps before commercialization. Those two product codes indicate Warby Park
picks.rationale: Two concrete FCC filings (SM-O200P/J) for Samsung's first Android XR glasses. This is the single card for the Samsung glasses cluster.

picks.headline: Hearing tech startup Legato launches its AI hearing glasses
picks.excerpt: The glasses stem from the startup’s goal of making hearing care more accessible by addressing the cost, comfort, and stigma associated with traditional hearing aids.
picks.rationale: A new product launch of AI hearing-aid glasses. It is a different company and device from Meta's hearing feature (09-28).

picks.headline: Google’s new Guided Vision feature can help you read the fine print
picks.excerpt: Can you trust AI to see what’s going on around you?
picks.rationale: A new Gemini Live camera feature (Guided Vision) for reading the world around you. It is separate from the Live Avatar release on 09-25.

picks.headline: Oura partners with Xella Health to combine your smart ring data with AI-powered biomarker testing
picks.excerpt: Oura spots the changes, Xella tries to explain why
picks.rationale: A new Oura integration that pairs ring data with AI biomarker screening for 130+ conditions. It adds a wearables/health angle to the set.

picks.headline: Gemini for Home is now better at hearing you in noisy rooms
picks.excerpt: Google Home’s latest update makes Gemini faster and more reliable, while fixing lights, cameras, setup, and more.
picks.rationale: Google's third September Gemini for Home release improves voice pickup in noisy rooms and fixes several smart-home issues. It is a new shipped update that adds smart-home coverage and a fifth outlet.

https://www.androidauthority.com/google-.new_action: A new Google Home release (the third September update, shipped 09-30) that improves Gemini's voice pickup in noisy rooms and speed, and fixes lights, cameras and setup. The 09-06 card covered an earlier, separate update.
